items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the fractured internal valve. One valve is estimated at €52 gross.
Section 7.1.9 covers connection elements that need renewal with the fractured valve. One hose is estimated at €27 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover necessary valve-repair labour. Three hours at about €100 gross per hour give €299 using the calibrated line estimate.

Sections 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.9 cover consumables actually used in the repair, but the generic line does not distinguish them from excluded small equipment under 3.6(c). If substantiated, €18 gross is reasonable for a small quantity.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 allow one attendance by the plumber for covered work. Same-wording references support €40 gross for the visit.

Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging needed to trace the escape, notwithstanding the ordinary tools exclusion. The €17.60 gross equipment charge is well within the €2,500 aggregate leak-location cap.

items.description: Facade damage from internally escaped water
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers render damaged when water from the internal escape froze, without the optional external-frost cover. Under 7.1.12, allow about €150 gross only if this line prices distinct local repair work rather than a heading or duplicate charge.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(a) cover removal of loose plaster in the area damaged by the internal escape. Allow €85 gross for local removal if separately charged without duplicating labour.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c)–(d) cover like-for-like base plaster on the affected patch. The comparable gross line estimate is €38.
Sections 7.1.12 and 9.6 require enough detail to allocate the charge to covered work on the affected patch. If itemisation establishes a distinct minor repair task, estimate €60 gross.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(c) cover necessary substrate preparation within the affected area. The comparable gross line estimate is €31.
Sections 7.1.5, 7.1.7(d) and 7.1.10 cover finishing the damaged patch only to the pre-loss specification and for the coats it requires. The comparable gross line estimate is €59.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c) cover necessary drying of the fabric saturated by the internal escape before reinstatement. The comparable gross line estimate is €254.
Sections 7.1.7(c)–(d) cover necessary priming of the repaired area for the like-for-like finish. The comparable gross line estimate is €117.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(f) cover labour on the damaged patch, not work on unaffected facade areas. Five hours at about €55 gross per hour give €277 using the calibrated line estimate.
Sections 3.6(b) and 7.1.12 exclude overhead charges, and this line identifies no covered task or attendance. If clarified as one eligible painter attendance under 7.1.11, estimate €40 gross.
